prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Ready to Meet Your Companion!", "Your pet is live on your desktop. Here is how to toggle visibility and interact whenever you need."]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Confirm your pet's official name and traits before bringing them to your desktop environment.", "Verified Companion"]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your adopted pet and preserve your progress across devices.", "Your adopted pet details will be linked permanently to this account."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay...", "We are verifying system overlay and desktop window display permissions."]
4: ["Secure Your Pet & Account Data", "Log in to guarantee your companion profile is safely synced and backed up.", "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore it instantly."]
5: ["Tip: If your pet does not appear on screen immediately, check your desktop taskbar icon to unhide it."]
6: ["Choose Your Path & Unlock Starter Perks", "Bonus: Free Starter Accessory Package"]
7: ["You will get a system notification as soon as your pet arrives on your desktop!"]
8: ["Desktop Initialization Status"]
9: ["Meet Your New Virtual Companion", "Pick a preset desktop companion or build a completely customized pet from your photos."]

verdicts.problem: Requests personal photos/information from the user
